### Would you like to advertise an open position here?

Reach bioinformaticians where they are and find the best candidates in the field.

Submit your advertisement through GitHub. After a quick review, it is added to
this page and removed automatically after the expiry date.

[Submit a job advertisement](https://github.com/Finnish-Society-for-Bioinformatics/website/issues/new?template=job-ad.yml){.btn .btn-dark .rounded-pill target="_blank"}

Position already filled?
[Remove the advertisement](https://github.com/Finnish-Society-for-Bioinformatics/website/issues/new?template=job-ad-remove.yml){target="_blank"}.

No GitHub account? [Send us an email](mailto:fsfbioinf@gmail.com) instead.

:::
